She hasn't sustained any serious injuries,[XENO:n ]
but her condition is far from stable.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT21 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Do you know what's wrong with her?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Her symptoms suggest ether deficiency.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

It's well-known that Homs are strongly[XENO:n ]
affected by ether levels in the environment.[XENO:n ]
But I've never seen symptoms like this before.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:jaw jaw=off ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ][XENO:line len=2 ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:jaw jaw=on ][XENO:del del=this ]

A sudden drop in ether content in the[XENO:n ]
surrounding atmosphere causes a reaction.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT18 ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Symptoms range from fatigue to nausea,[XENO:n ]
but in this girl's case...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]What can we do?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]We're gonna need Water-type Ether Crystals.[XENO:n ]
I'll load the crystals into a cartridge[XENO:n ]
to shoot from my rifle.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]You're gonna shoot her?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT3 ]No, silly. I'll fire them into the air and[XENO:n ]
the dispersed ether will heal her.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]That's what I thought.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]But the problem is the crystals.[XENO:n ]
We can't just use any old crystal,[XENO:n ]
they must be as pure as possible.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

This area must have a water source nearby.[XENO:n ]
We should search there first.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I spotted a waterfall a little way back.[XENO:n ]
What do you think, Carna?[XENO:n ]
Would a waterfall produce pure crystals?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I can't think of a better place.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Then it's decided.[XENO:n ]
I'll search for the crystals.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Hey, you're not going on your own![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I'll be OK. Rein, you and the others keep watch here.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

We're short on water too,[XENO:n ]
so I'll fill up our flasks.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]Hey, good idea.[XENO:n ]
Take care man![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
